items: A friendly legend that has walked the route and come home now guards exactly like the island's own home legend: it stands where the home legend stands (a spot of its own beside it) and fights what comes into its reach, rather than rushing to defend you first

Home legends can become party legends: the island's home legend and a legend back from the route both take letters, and the 100th gives it the giant party hat; pick up its sigil and you are on its short leash, put the sigil down and it goes back to guarding home
A home-guarding legend put back at its post now stops there instead of keeping its run
